### Core Services
1. **SaaS Web Apps & Custom Platforms**: Building production-ready Software as a Service (SaaS), CRMs, ERPs, admin dashboards, and scalable web platforms with secure authentication (RBAC), relational databases, and payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Mercado Pago).
2. **High-Converting Landing Pages**: Ultra-fast web pages, 95-100 score on Google PageSpeed Insights, technical SEO, high-conversion copywriting, and complete tracking with Google Tag Manager (GTM), GA4, and Meta Pixel.
3. **Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)**: Modern web applications installable directly onto mobile home screens without Apple/Google app store fees, featuring offline capabilities and push notifications.
4. **Business Automation & AI Engineering**: LLM integrations (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), automated operational pipelines, smart sales/support chatbots, and intelligent data processing.
5. **Web Performance & Technical SEO**: Core Web Vitals audit, technical on-page SEO, architecture modernization, and web security best practices.

### Technology Stack
- **Front-End**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons.
- **Back-End & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Next.js API Routes, RESTful APIs, Webhooks.
- **Databases**: SQL and NoSQL (leveraging both Supabase and Firebase across both relational and non-relational database models, plus PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and MongoDB).
- **DevOps, CI/CD & Hosting**: GitHub Actions, Git, Hostinger FTPS, Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare.
- **Analytics & Tracking**: Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, Schema.org JSON-LD.

### Geographic Reach
